sourcePolicy: Prepared only fixed round15 target intersections for seven parent-selected TCGdex catalogue renders, the existing approved SPEC-0409 photo, and the parent-reviewed Russian owner-uploaded BKT 118 reverse-holo photo, and one parent-reviewed official Japanese XY-P 149 render. CAT-053 was excluded because its target requires the Build-A-Bear stamp, which the unmarked TCGdex render does not show. No specimen IDs allocated, no photo filing/upload, no canonical edits, no network calls. Existing SPEC-0409 bytes and registry entry were reused unchanged. The owner-uploaded image is not attributed to a physical owner; exact-printing photo identity is supported by the visible Russian card face and treatment.
